title: PCP constant must be uniform over the infinite family of rank-k projectors (thm:pcp)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**[proof-gap | LOAD-BEARING]** `thm:pcp` / `def:pcp` / `eq:pcpdef`.

The clean strict-rank-$k$ $(1+\varepsilon)$ guarantee needs a PCP constant $c$ such that for **every** rank-$\le k$ orthogonal projector $\Pi$ on $\mathbb R^m$, the Gaussian sketch preserves $\|(I-\Pi)A\|_F^2$ to within $\eta$. The proof asserts an OSE on a fixed $\le 2k$-dim subspace plus approximate matrix multiplication 'yield eq:pcpdef uniformly over all $\Pi$.'

Missing, load-bearing:
1. The constant $c$ (independent of $\Pi$) is never produced; its $\Pi$-independence is the technical heart of Cohen-Elder-Musco-Musco-Persu (STOC 2015).
2. The reduction of the **infinite** family $\{\Pi\}$ to a **single** fixed $\le 2k$-dimensional subspace embedding (net + perturbation) is not justified.

This is the only place the strict rank-$k$ object (what part (a) actually demands) gets a clean $(1+\varepsilon)$ bound. Reproduce CEMMP Thm 12: put the union of column spaces of $A_k$ and $\Pi A$ in a $\le 2k$-dim subspace, apply a $(1\pm\eta_0)$ subspace embedding there ($\gamma$-net + $\chi^2$ tail + union bound) for an absolute $c$, then AMM for the cross term; write $c$ explicitly.
